name: TVS Commercial Grade Heavy Hex M18x2.5mm Assembly Nut (Pack of 20)
shortDescription: High-tensile Grade 10 cold-forged heavy hex nut (M18 x 2.5mm pitch) with anti-galling black phosphate finish for heavy commercial automotive and structural joints.
overview: TVS Fasteners is India's pre-eminent OEM manufacturer of high-tensile safety-critical threaded fasteners. This M18 x 2.5mm property class Grade 10 assembly nut is engineered for heavy commercial vehicle axles, suspension spring packs, structural steel flange assemblies, and high-vibration heavy industrial machinery. Cold-forged from high-grade alloy steel and heat-treated to an ultimate proof load stress exceeding 1000 MPa, it features a heavy hex body that distributes clamp force across a broad bearing area. The black manganese phosphate and oil finish repels rust while preventing thread galling during high-torque air impact wrench tightening.
